turn.user_message: Yes, that’s exactly it. Show me how to fix it.
turn.context: Discharge sample conversation, turn 4 (playbook §3: a short intro, the five parts as options, one overview drawing).

text: Here is what the fix is made of. It has five parts.
None of them needs a new hospital system on day one. They sit on top of how you work today.
chat.invite: Open any door to see what is behind it. Or tell me which part worries you most.
chat.note: Five parts, one aim: put the evening to work.

points.label: How we will know it worked

prompts: Which part saves the most time?
Do we need to hire anyone?
chat.pointer: Five doors off one corridor. Open any one to see what it answers.

blocks.title: What the fix is made of
blocks.deck: Five parts. Each door says the question its part answers.

blocks.corridor: One corridor. Open the doors in any order.

doors.title: Automatic paperwork
doors.question: What the software does, so nobody does the work twice

doors.title: Changes on the wards
doors.question: What each team does differently, and when it starts

doors.title: People who must agree
doors.question: Who has to say yes, and who gives up the most

doors.title: Who is in charge
doors.question: Whether you need anyone new, sized on your own numbers

doors.title: How we will know
doors.question: The few numbers we watch, week by week

sheets.title: Automatic paperwork
sheets.text: The papers and the bill start on the evening round, by themselves. Other hospitals saved 6 to 8 hours for each patient. Not yet measured here.
sheets.entry: Which paperwork takes longest on your wards?

sheets.title: Changes on the wards
sheets.text: Most of the work stays the same. What changes is when it starts, and who writes it.
sheets.entry: What would you most like to change on the ward?

ask.label: Open part 2
ask.say: Show me the changes on the wards

sheets.title: People who must agree
sheets.text: Several teams touch discharge, but only a few change much. One person has to approve the new order.

lines.label: It answers
lines.value: Nobody in charge of the whole discharge

ask.label: Open part 3
ask.say: Show me the people who must agree

sheets.title: Who is in charge
sheets.text: One person owns discharge, with helpers for the busy hours. Sized on your numbers, not a rule of thumb.

lines.label: It answers
lines.value: Nobody in charge of the whole discharge

sheets.entry: Who owns discharge today, if anyone?

ask.label: Open part 4
ask.say: Show me who is in charge

sheets.title: How we will know
sheets.text: A short list of numbers, watched week by week, starting from your own.

lines.label: It answers
lines.value: Whether any of it is working

sheets.entry: Which numbers do you look at each week now?

ask.label: Open part 5
ask.say: Show me how we’ll know it worked

blocks.label: The aim of all five
blocks.sub: Your doctors sign in the morning what they already decided the night before.
